Q3 Planning — Product / Engineering / Ops Sync

2026-08-27
Priya — PM Marcus — Eng Lead Jenna — Ops Dan — Design Sara — VP Product

Key Decisions & Points

  • Reconciliation engine (Q3 anchor): Multi-currency batches are failing — three incidents this quarter, reconciliation-related support tickets up 40% QoQ.
    • Build vs. buy evaluated: Recur ($180K/yr) and LedgerFlow ($140K/yr, lacks jurisdiction-specific tax code support) both still need ~3 engineer-weeks of integration — decided against.
    • Decision: build in-house. Estimated at 6 engineer-weeks, including an FX rounding module migration, plus 2 weeks of support from Karim (Platform) for ledger integration.
  • Mobile receipt-capture: Design flows complete; prototype tested with 6 users.
    • Testing surfaced two requests: bulk-select before upload, and a more prominent OCR confidence indicator.
    • Decision: ship v1 without bulk-select (out of current scope, would cost ~1 sprint); log it as a fast-follow on the roadmap.
  • Vendor payout SLA: Target is 48-hour payout from invoice approval; current p95 is 71 hours.
    • Two bottlenecks identified: manual approval routing (Ops) and the ACH batching window (Eng).
    • Proposed fix: cut ACH batch window from 12h to 4h, add a second west-coast-shift approver — projected to hit 48h p95 by mid-Q3.
    • Cutting the batch window adds monitoring overhead — ~half a sprint of eng time and requires SRE sign-off before proceeding.
  • Deprioritized / unchanged items: Audit-log retention update pushed to Q4 (confirmed with Legal); internal admin-tool refresh remains with the intern crew, no changes.
  • Team health: HR flagged rising bug-bash burnout on engineering; a rotating on-call structure was requested as a lightweight proposal.
